rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A TypeScript-based server that provides complete access to Cisco Intersight's infrastructure management API through 30+ specialized tools covering inventory discovery, alarm monitoring, policy management, resource pools, and server profile orchestration. Built with robust authentication supporting both RSA and ECDSA API keys, it enables datacenter automation including server provisioning, policy creation and attachment, pool management for IP/MAC/UUID/WWNN/WWPN resources, and real-time infrastructure monitoring with alarm acknowledgment capabilities. The implementation features structured TypeScript interfaces for all Intersight object types and supports advanced OData filtering, making it useful for automated infrastructure provisioning workflows, datacenter health monitoring, policy-as-code implementations, and AI-assisted server lifecycle management.
